# Wegmans Grocery Catalog & Category Price Extractor

Wegmans is a major US grocery chain with a full online storefront covering dairy, meat, produce, seafood, frozen and bakery departments. This actor pulls live product listings from that storefront by keyword search, by department category, or from Wegmans' curated featured collections.

## What this actor does

- Searches the full Wegmans catalog by free-text keyword
- Browses a single department category grid (32 curated categories across Dairy, Meat, Produce, Frozen, Seafood and Bakery)
- Browses one of Wegmans' evergreen featured/discovery collections
- Filters results by price range and minimum star rating
- Empty fields are omitted from records

## Output per product

- `productId` — Wegmans numeric product identifier
- `name` — product name
- `size` — package size/weight, e.g. `1 gallon`
- `price` — shelf price in USD
- `pricePerUnit` — price per standard unit, e.g. `$2.99/gallon`
- `category` — department category
- `rating` — average customer star rating
- `reviewCount` — number of customer reviews
- `badge` — merchandising badge shown on the tile, e.g. `New Item`, `Hot Zone`
- `dietaryTags` — wellness/dietary tags shown on the tile, e.g. `Gluten-Free`, `Organic`, `Vegan`, `Family Pack`
- `imageUrl` — product image URL
- `productUrl` — direct link to the product page
- `sourceUrl` — the search/category/collection URL the product was found on
- `recordType` — always `product`
- `scrapedAt` — timestamp of extraction

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string | `search` | `search`, `byCategory` or `deals` |
| `searchQuery` | string | `milk` | Free-text product keyword (mode=search) |
| `category` | string | `milk` | Department category to browse (mode=byCategory) |
| `dealsCollection` | string | `seasonal_entertaining` | Featured collection to browse (mode=deals) |
| `minPrice` | number | – | Drop products cheaper than this (USD) |
| `maxPrice` | number | – | Drop products pricier than this (USD) |
| `minRating` | number | – | Drop products with a lower average star rating (0–5) |
| `maxItems` | integer | `30` | Hard cap on emitted records (1–150) |

### Example: keyword search with price filter

```json
{
  "mode": "search",
  "searchQuery": "chicken breast",
  "minPrice": 2,
  "maxPrice": 15,
  "maxItems": 30
}
```

### Example: browse a category

```json
{
  "mode": "byCategory",
  "category": "fresh_fish",
  "minRating": 4,
  "maxItems": 50
}
```

### Example: browse a featured collection

```json
{
  "mode": "deals",
  "dealsCollection": "gluten_free",
  "maxItems": 20
}
```

## Use cases

- **Grocery price tracking** — monitor prices and unit prices across staple categories over time
- **Dietary-filtered shopping lists** — pull products tagged `Gluten-Free`, `Organic` or `Vegan` for meal planning
- **Catalog and assortment research** — see what's stocked in a given department
- **Competitive grocery analysis** — compare Wegmans pricing against other regional chains
- **Review-driven curation** — surface only highly rated products with `minRating`

## FAQ

**Is this affiliated with Wegmans?** No. This is an independent catalog extraction tool and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Wegmans Food Markets.

**Do I need an account to search products?** No. Search, category and collection pages are all publicly browsable without login.

**What are `dietaryTags`?** Wegmans marks some products with small wellness icons on the product tile — Gluten-Free, Organic, Vegan, Lactose Free and Family Pack are the most common. The field is omitted for products with no such tags.

**Does this include sale or clearance pricing?** Wegmans does not publish discount or "was/now" pricing on its public storefront, so `price` always reflects the real, publicly visible shelf price. The `deals` mode surfaces Wegmans' curated featured/discovery collections rather than discount data, since Wegmans doesn't publish one publicly.

**Which categories are available?** 32 categories spanning Dairy, Meat, Produce, Frozen, Seafood and Bakery — see the `category` input for the full list.

**Why does `category` sometimes show a different value than I selected?** When Wegmans' own tile data includes a more specific category label, that is used instead of the requested filter; otherwise the requested category is used as a fallback.

**How many products can one run return?** Up to `maxItems`, capped at 150 per run.
